name: domain:intent-routing
description: Customer support: Send each request to the right skill, and say "none" when it fits none. Questions verbatim from cookbooks/intent-routing/spec.json (measured wording). compose returns in-scope unless Jev picked the escape option; the routed area is the choice itself, gated by the confidence cut in rule.frozen.json.

artifact.type: one user utterance to a virtual assistant

modules.name: skill-routing
modules.purpose: Which of ten assistant skill areas owns this request, or none of them?

domain.instructions: A user said this to a task assistant that supports only the tasks listed below. Which area does the request belong to? If it is not one of the listed supported tasks, answer none.

criteria.banking: Bank accounts, bills and payments. The request is one of these supported tasks: freeze account; routing; pin change; bill due; pay bill; account blocked; interest rate; min payment; bill balance; transfer; order checks; balance; spending history; transactions; report fraud.
criteria.credit_cards: Credit cards, card rewards and credit scores. The request is one of these supported tasks: replacement card duration; expiration date; damaged card; improve credit score; report lost card; card declined; credit limit change; apr; redeem rewards; credit limit; rewards balance; application status; credit score; new card; international fees.
criteria.kitchen_and_dining: Cooking, food and restaurants. The request is one of these supported tasks: food last; confirm reservation; how busy; ingredients list; calories; nutrition info; recipe; restaurant reviews; restaurant reservation; meal suggestion; restaurant suggestion; cancel reservation; ingredient substitution; cook time; accept reservations.
criteria.home: Household organising: lists, reminders, calendar, music, shopping orders and smart-home devices. The request is one of these supported tasks: what song; play music; todo list update; reminder; reminder update; calendar update; order status; update playlist; shopping list; calendar; next song; order; todo list; shopping list update; smart home.
criteria.auto_and_commute: The car and getting around by road. The request is one of these supported tasks: current location; oil change when; oil change how; uber; traffic; tire pressure; schedule maintenance; gas; mpg; distance; directions; last maintenance; gas type; tire change; jump start.
criteria.travel: Trips abroad, flights, hotels and travel documents. The request is one of these supported tasks: plug type; travel notification; translate; flight status; international visa; timezone; exchange rate; travel suggestion; travel alert; vaccines; lost luggage; book flight; book hotel; carry on; car rental.
criteria.utility: Everyday phone utilities: time, weather, alarms, timers, calls, texts, quick lookups and conversions. The request is one of these supported tasks: weather; alarm; date; find phone; share location; timer; make call; calculator; definition; measurement conversion; flip coin; spelling; time; roll dice; text.
criteria.work: The user's job: pay, time off, benefits, taxes and meetings. The request is one of these supported tasks: pto request status; next holiday; insurance change; insurance; meeting schedule; payday; taxes; income; rollover 401k; pto balance; pto request; w2; schedule meeting; direct deposit; pto used.
criteria.small_talk: Chit-chat with the assistant about itself or social pleasantries. The request is one of these supported tasks: who made you; meaning of life; who do you work for; do you have pets; what are your hobbies; fun fact; what is your name; where are you from; goodbye; thank you; greeting; tell joke; are you a bot; how old are you; what can i ask you.
criteria.meta: Controlling the conversation or the assistant's own settings, and bare replies such as yes, no or maybe. The request is one of these supported tasks: change speed; user name; whisper mode; yes; change volume; no; change language; repeat; change accent; cancel; sync device; change user name; change ai name; reset settings; maybe.
criteria.none: The request is not one of the supported tasks listed in any option above, even if it is about a similar topic (for example a banking or car question that is not one of the listed banking or car tasks), or it is a general-knowledge, news, maths or other request the assistant does not support.

domain.note: The decision (labelled): 10 skill areas plus `none`, the escape option. Each option lists the tasks that area covers, so the question is literal: which listed set does this request belong to?

asksAction.instructions: Does the user ask the assistant to perform an action or change something (for example set, book, send, play, add, cancel, change, turn on), rather than ask for information?
asksAction.note: true = asks the assistant to do something; false = asks for information or chats. A routing hint, not used by the rule.

mentionsMoney.instructions: Does the utterance mention money, a payment, a bill, a price, a bank account, a credit card or pay?
mentionsMoney.note: true = money or an account is mentioned. Points at banking, credit cards or pay.

aboutAssistant.instructions: Is the utterance about the assistant itself: who or what it is, its name, its voice, its language, its speed or volume, or its settings?
aboutAssistant.note: true = about the assistant itself (name, voice, settings). Separates small talk and meta from tasks.

compose.positive: request is in scope for a skill

notForJev.instead: Code: the confidence gate fitted on the fit split.

notForJev.judgement: Is it in scope at all?
notForJev.instead: Code: `domain !== "none"`. Asking again would duplicate the choice.
A second, narrower choice inside the chosen area (not built here).

notForJev.judgement: Has this user asked before, and what did we answer?
